_about: Public links shown on the site (owner, 2026-11-10 and 2026-11-12). Not settings: the city's settings file has no field for these. code_url: the public code repository (Progress and About pages). instagram: the project's Instagram account, linked from the footer as plain text (no embed, script or image from Instagram). contact_form (decision 0046): where the Contact page form posts (the private Worker), and the Cloudflare Turnstile site key, which is public.
